reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, launch_date
FROM products
WHERE launch_date = (SELECT MAX(launch_date) FROM products)
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.launch_date
FROM products p
JOIN (
  -- one row in total
  SELECT MAX(launch_date) AS last_launch
  FROM products
) AS m ON m.last_launch = p.launch_date

WITH last_launch AS (
  -- one row in total
  SELECT MAX(launch_date) AS launch_date
  FROM products
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.launch_date
FROM products p
JOIN last_launch l ON l.launch_date = p.launch_date

other_way.sql:
WITH last_launch AS (
  -- one row in total
  SELECT MAX(launch_date) AS launch_date
  FROM products
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.launch_date
FROM products p
JOIN last_launch l ON l.launch_date = p.launch_date
other_way.tradeoff: A WITH step that holds the latest date, joined on launch_date, gives the same rows in more lines.
